name: Evernote
description_en:
Evernote combines notes, notebooks, attachments, tasks and calendar-linked context in an account-based workspace. Its Web Clipper captures reference material while search and organisation tools help retrieve it later. The current plan comparison uses Free, Starter and Advanced for individual accounts; older plan names and directory prices should not be assumed current.

Its value is in keeping source material, notes and follow-up work connected. Evaluate the limits of your intended plan and the ability to export your library before moving an existing archive.
description_zh:
Evernote 把笔记、笔记本、附件、任务及日历关联内容放在账户式工作区中。Web Clipper 用于采集参考资料，搜索和组织工具用于后续检索。当前个人套餐对照采用 Free、Starter 和 Advanced；不能默认旧套餐名称与目录价格仍然有效。

它的价值在于连接参考材料、笔记和后续工作。迁移已有资料库前，应核对目标套餐限制以及导出资料库的能力。

core_features.explanation_en: Save web reference material into the note library.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把网页参考资料保存至笔记库。

core_features.explanation_en: Organise notes and connect follow-up work; plan entitlements apply.
core_features.explanation_zh: 组织笔记并关联后续工作，受套餐条件约束。

core_features.explanation_en: Desktop export supports notes or whole notebooks, including for Free users.
core_features.explanation_zh: 桌面端支持导出笔记或整个笔记本，免费用户也可使用。

en: Capture reference pages into project notebooks.
Link meeting context with follow-up work.
zh: 把参考网页采集至项目笔记本。
将会议上下文与后续工作关联。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Account-based apps for web, iOS, Android, Windows and Mac.
Deployment.zh: 基于账户的 Web、iOS、Android、Windows 和 Mac 应用。

steps.en: Create a notebook and clip a representative webpage.
steps.zh: 创建笔记本并剪藏一个代表性网页。

steps.en: Check note, device and attachment limits against the planned library.
steps.zh: 按计划迁移的资料库核对笔记、设备和附件限制。

steps.en: Install a desktop app and inspect an ENEX or HTML export before migration.
steps.zh: 安装桌面应用，迁移前检查 ENEX 或 HTML 导出。

items.en: The export help article requires Evernote for Mac or Windows; Web cannot export ENEX/HTML. You can export up to 100 selected notes or an entire notebook, choose ENEX or single/multi-page HTML and include attributes such as tags and dates. Free users can export too. For migration or backup, inspect attachments and metadata in a representative export before relying on the full archive. An export file does not itself prove another app will preserve all internal structures.
items.zh: 导出帮助要求使用 Mac 或 Windows 版 Evernote；Web 无法导出 ENEX／HTML。可导出最多 100 篇选中笔记或整个笔记本，选择 ENEX、单页／多页 HTML，并包含标签、日期等属性。免费用户也可以导出。迁移或备份时，应先检查代表性导出中的附件与元数据，再依赖整个归档。拥有导出文件不代表其他应用能保留所有内部结构。

pricing.billing_basis: Account subscription; monthly/yearly options; enterprise terms differ.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free exists with small library/device limits. Starter/Advanced amounts were not exposed clearly; normal paid trial seven days.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 存在且资料库／设备上限较小。Starter／Advanced 金额未清晰显示；普通付费试用为七天。

Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: Capture a source, then build usable notes
sections.title_zh: 先采集来源，再整理成可用笔记
sections.en: For a proposed project-research workflow, clip a relevant webpage, place it in the project notebook and add a note explaining why it matters. Evernote documents templates, tags, search, tasks and calendar-linked notes. Use the clip as reference material and keep your conclusions distinguishable from it. A captured page is not a promise that interactive content or a subsequently changed website can be reconstructed perfectly.
sections.zh: 例如进行项目研究时，可以剪藏相关网页，放入项目笔记本，再写一段说明其意义的笔记。Evernote 文档列有模板、标签、搜索、任务与日历关联笔记。剪藏内容应作为参考，与自己的结论分开。保存网页不代表能完美重现交互内容或后来变化的网站。

sections.title_en: The Free plan has a small library ceiling
sections.title_zh: 免费方案的资料库上限较小
sections.en: The plan comparison lists Free at 50 notes, one notebook, 20 tags, 200 attachments, 1 GB storage and one device. Starter lists 1,000 notes, 20 notebooks, 5 GB and three devices; Advanced advertises unlimited notes and devices subject to safeguard limits. These are account-plan conditions, not limits inferred from how many features appear on the homepage. Confirm existing-account and checkout treatment before migration.
sections.zh: 套餐对照列出 Free 为 50 篇笔记、一个笔记本、20 个标签、200 个附件、1 GB 存储和一台设备。Starter 为 1,000 篇笔记、20 个笔记本、5 GB 和三台设备；Advanced 宣传不限笔记和设备，但有防滥用保护限制。这些是账户套餐条件，不能从首页功能数量推断。迁移前应确认现有账户与结账时适用的规则。

sections.title_en: Subscription terms without an invented price
sections.title_zh: 订阅条件与未确定价格
sections.en: The retrieved comparison did not expose an unambiguous payable individual subscription amount, so no monthly price is normalised here. It supports monthly or yearly billing for Starter and Advanced. The FAQ normally gives seven days for paid-plan trials unless otherwise specified and 14 days for Enterprise. A paid trial is separate from Free. Subscriptions purchased through Apple or Google must be managed through that store; cancellation before a trial ends avoids its charge under the documented conditions.
sections.zh: 本次读取的对照页没有给出明确可支付的个人订阅金额，因此不填写标准化月价。Starter 与 Advanced 支持按月或按年付款。FAQ 通常规定付费套餐试用七天，另有说明除外；Enterprise 为 14 天。付费试用与 Free 不同。通过 Apple 或 Google 购买的订阅需在相应商店管理；按文档条件在试用结束前取消可避免该次收费。

sections.en: The export help article requires Evernote for Mac or Windows; Web cannot export ENEX/HTML. You can export up to 100 selected notes or an entire notebook, choose ENEX or single/multi-page HTML and include attributes such as tags and dates. Free users can export too. For migration or backup, inspect attachments and metadata in a representative export before relying on the full archive. An export file does not itself prove another app will preserve all internal structures.
sections.zh: 导出帮助要求使用 Mac 或 Windows 版 Evernote；Web 无法导出 ENEX／HTML。可导出最多 100 篇选中笔记或整个笔记本，选择 ENEX、单页／多页 HTML，并包含标签、日期等属性。免费用户也可以导出。迁移或备份时，应先检查代表性导出中的附件与元数据，再依赖整个归档。拥有导出文件不代表其他应用能保留所有内部结构。

sections.title_en: Check retrieval and sharing, not feature counts
sections.en: Evernote is worth evaluating for a mixed reference library with clipped pages, documents and follow-up tasks. A Markdown-first local folder or a dedicated task tracker may be simpler for a narrower need; this is selection guidance, not an approved alternative relationship. No self-hosted distribution or open-source licence was established. AI-related plan availability, transcription quality, shared-library permissions and offline behaviour should be tested on the intended platform.
sections.zh: 如果资料库混合网页剪藏、文档和后续任务，Evernote 值得评估。较窄的需求可能用 Markdown 本地文件夹或专用任务工具更简单；这只是选型建议，未批准任何替代关系。本次没有确认自行部署发行版或开源许可。AI 的套餐适用范围、转录质量、共享资料库权限及离线行为，应在目标平台测试。

research_gaps.en: Current payable regional subscription prices, full AI entitlements and live sync/collaboration/import fidelity were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实当前地区实际订阅金额、完整 AI 权益及真实同步／协作／导入保真度。
